sub-zero.title: Sub-Zero
sub-zero.lede: Top Appliances Repair services Sub-Zero built-in refrigerators, freezers, wine storage and undercounter units across Houston and nearby cities. We come out the same day, give you a free estimate before any work starts and cover the repair with a 90-day warranty on parts and labor.

problems.p: Sub-Zero built-ins use two separate sealed systems. When one evaporator or its fan fails, one compartment stays cold while the other warms up — a symptom that points straight to which system needs work.

problems.t: Ice on the evaporator or unit running constantly
problems.p: A defrost heater, defrost thermostat or control fault lets frost build on the coil until airflow stops and the compressor runs non-stop.

problems.t: Condenser warnings and high temperature alarms
problems.p: The condenser on a built-in is behind the upper grille and packs with dust and pet hair. Restricted airflow raises temperatures and triggers the service light.
A hardened or torn gasket on a heavy built-in door lets humid Houston air in, which shows up as condensation, frost and longer run times.

notes.h: Built-in and integrated units stay in the cabinet
notes.p: Replacing a Sub-Zero means matching a cabinet opening, trim and panels, so repairing is almost always the sensible option. We service the unit in place and protect the surrounding cabinetry and flooring while we work.

notes.h: Classic, Designer and PRO series
notes.p: We work on the older Classic built-ins, the Designer panel-ready models and PRO units, as well as undercounter refrigerator and wine drawers. Having the model and serial number from the plate inside the door helps us bring the right parts.

faqs.q: Do you repair Sub-Zero refrigerators in Houston?
faqs.a: Yes. Sub-Zero built-in and integrated refrigerators, freezers, wine storage and undercounter units are among the appliances we service most. We offer same-day visits across Houston and nearby cities.

faqs.q: Why is one side of my Sub-Zero cold and the other warm?
faqs.a: Most Sub-Zero built-ins run dual refrigeration — a separate sealed system for the refrigerator and the freezer. When one compartment holds temperature and the other does not, the problem is usually that system's evaporator fan, defrost circuit or control.

faqs.q: Is it worth repairing a Sub-Zero instead of replacing it?
faqs.a: Usually yes. These are built-in units sized to a cabinet opening, so replacement means cabinetry work on top of the appliance cost. Common failures — fans, defrost parts, gaskets, control boards and condenser cleaning — are contained repairs.

faqs.q: How often should a Sub-Zero condenser be cleaned?
faqs.a: Roughly twice a year, and more often in a home with pets. A clogged condenser is one of the most common reasons a Sub-Zero runs warm or triggers a service alarm in Houston's heat.

faqs.q: Is the estimate free?
faqs.a: Yes. The technician diagnoses the unit and gives you a free estimate before any work begins, so you decide with the price in front of you.
